verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic access is a fair question for a government employer-tax service, since agencies can offer filing APIs or batch interfaces, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API, CLI, or headless mode: OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown probes all return 404, and the apps.twc.texas.gov host behind UTR/UTS drops keyless agent connections. QuickFile is an installed desktop tool for importing a formatted wage file, which is adjacent to this story rather than CI-style automation, so it earns no credit.
